Future Beauty Brands is an entrepreneurial, privately held / private equity backed company that creates and distributes strong brands of makeup tools, body care accessories and skincare brands in over 90 countries.

Our 70+ year old company is a high-growth, beauty business with a focus on exceptional quality products at affordable prices developed through innovation and on-trend design. Future Beauty Brands has a very fast paced culture, with the senior management team coming from major CPG companies and having strong records of growing businesses.
JOB TITLE: National Account Manager Drug/Sephora
DEPT/LOCATION: US Sales/Hybrid
REPORTS TO: Senior Sales Director - Beauty
Key Internal Relationships: Trade Marketing, Operations, Purchasing, Marketing and Product Development
Key External Relationships: Category Managers, DMM, buyer/replenishment, marketing

National Account Manager for a number of strategic customers that develops, plans and executes both brand and customer goals in a jointly profitable outcome:
Owning and hitting/exceeding annual sales targets within assigned territory and accounts.
Developing and executing strategic plan to achieve sales targets and expand our customer base.
Building and maintaining strong, long-lasting customer and internal relationships.
Managing and developing team to deliver on corporate strategic goals and develop talent within team.

Exceed sales budget targets by developing and executing a strategic customer plan that includes: expanding distribution, launching innovation, executing a measured promotional plan and pivoting when appropriate.
Grow P&L contribution by growing top line sales, reducing operational costs and maximizing ROI on trade/markdown spend.
Increase share of brands by expanding into new markets or customers, replacing competitive brands in existing retailers and creating a beauty statement within each category.
Create an award-winning team with direct oversight of brokers and working directly with retailers.
Maintain accurate weekly S&OP forecasts by customer or region by reporting on-time sku movement, layering in promotional influence and understanding customer current weeks of supply.
Develop, maintain and create customer or regional reporting for both internal and external use: examples are not limited to weekly POS, syndicated dates analytics, NPD performance tracking, holiday sell-through and Adhoc analysis.
Lead internal planning and execute plans by creating, evaluating and managing profitable/strategic opportunity briefs and promotional plans.
Predict the needs of the audience for sales/customer meetings by understanding the customers needs and requirements, combining internal goals, setting cadence to productive meetings and following up with concise actions.
Minimum 3-5 years sales experience of calling on national accounts

Track record of setting, measuring and achieving goals
BA/BS required
Self-motivated and highly driven
Strong Presentation skills
Strong computer skills

Eightfold is a global leader in an AI-native enterprise talent platform , trusted by the world’s largest & most respected Fortune 500 organizations.

Our platform is built from the ground up, operating at scale across Azure and AWS, deployed in multiple regions globally, including IL4-compliant environments for the US Government, supporting users in 100+ countries and 30+ languages.

Today, Eightfold is at the forefront of agentic AI, delivering intelligent agents that actively drive outcomes across hiring and talent workflows, while much of the industry is still experimenting with prototypes. Backed by over $410M in funding and valued at $2B+, we are defining the next era of agentic talent systems.
What sets Eightfold apart is not just the technology & our mission, but the team behind it. We are a deeply technical, execution-driven organization that values ownership, collaboration, and high standards.

Our engineers, product leaders, and go-to-market teams work closely together — in person and across functions — to build systems that scale in the real world. If you’re excited to work on hard problems, move with urgency, raise the bar every day, and help build agentic systems that transform how the world works, Eightfold is the place to do it.

The Sr. Client Partner is a senior individual contributor within the Solution Delivery - Service Sales organization responsible for driving services revenue, solution strategy, and implementation readiness across complex enterprise customer engagements.
As a trusted advisor to customers and internal stakeholders, the Sr. Client Partner partners closely with Sales, Solution Delivery, Customer Success, Alliances, Finance, and Legal teams to develop implementation strategies that accelerate customer value realization while supporting Eightfold’s growth objectives.
The Sr. Client Partner owns the full professional services sales lifecycle from discovery and solution strategy through estimation, Statement of Work (SOW) creation, commercial negotiation, and deal closure. This role ensures that services engagements are strategically aligned, commercially sound, operationally executable, and positioned to achieve successful customer outcomes.
As one of the most experienced members of the Services Sales organization, the Sr. Client Partner also provides mentorship, guidance, and subject matter expertise to peers while contributing to the evolution of services offerings, sales processes, and go-to-market strategy.

Professional Services Sales & Solution Strategy
Lead the Services sales process for new customer implementations, expansions, and transformation initiatives.
Partner with Account Executives and customers to develop implementation strategies that support business objectives and product adoption.
Facilitate discovery sessions to understand customer requirements, operating models, technical environments, and success criteria.
Translate business and technical requirements into scalable implementation approaches and services solutions.
Position Solution Delivery as a strategic enabler of customer outcomes and long-term platform value.
Statement of Work (SOW) Development & Commercial Ownership
Own the development, authoring, review, and negotiation of Statements of Work (SOWs) for customer engagements.
Define project scope, assumptions, deliverables, milestones, implementation approach, staffing models, and success criteria.
Develop effort estimates, resource plans, pricing models, and commercial structures that balance customer value, delivery feasibility, and profitability objectives.
Lead services-related contract discussions and partner with Legal, Procurement, and customer stakeholders through negotiation and execution.
Manage scope alignment throughout the sales cycle and ensure smooth transition into delivery.
Support change requests and scope modifications as customer needs evolve.
Deal Strategy & Cross-Functional Leadership
Serve as the primary Services Sales advisor for strategic opportunities and complex enterprise deals.
Partner with Solution Delivery leaders to validate implementation approaches, staffing assumptions, and execution readiness.
Collaborate with Customer Success teams to identify adoption risks, expansion opportunities, and services-led value acceleration initiatives.
Support partner-led and co-delivered engagements through joint planning, solution validation, and services strategy alignment.
Act as a trusted advisor to internal stakeholders throughout the deal lifecycle.
Forecasting, Financial Performance & Operational Excellence
Maintain accurate services pipeline, bookings forecasts, and opportunity tracking within CRM systems.
Drive forecast accuracy through disciplined opportunity management and proactive risk identification.
Ensure engagements align with pricing guidelines, margin targets, and business objectives.
Partner with Finance and Delivery leadership to provide visibility into services demand, resource requirements, and revenue forecasts.
Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, sales effectiveness, and commercial consistency.
Services Innovation & Organizational Impact
Contribute to the development of packaged services offerings, implementation accelerators, and scalable delivery models.
Provide feedback and market insights that influence Solution Delivery strategy and go-to-market priorities.
Mentor Client Partners and contribute to the development of services sales best practices.
Support onboarding, enablement, and knowledge sharing across the Services Sales organization.
Participate in strategic initiatives designed to improve forecasting, service offerings, sales tools, methodologies, and customer outcomes.

8+ years of experience in enterprise software, SaaS, consulting, professional services sales, solution consulting, or implementation services.
Proven track record selling and negotiating complex Professional Services engagements in enterprise environments.
Extensive experience creating and negotiating Statements of Work, project scopes, pricing structures, and commercial agreements.
Strong understanding of implementation methodologies, enterprise software deployments, systems integration, and customer transformation programs.
Excellent executive communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.

Experience supporting HCM, Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, HR Technology, AI, or Enterprise SaaS solutions.
Experience working with partner-delivered implementation models and global systems integrators.
Consulting background with a leading systems integrator, enterprise software company, or management consulting firm.
Experience selling or contracting within U.S. federal, state, or local government environments, including familiarity with government procurement processes, compliance requirements, and public sector implementation programs.
We are a team of self-starters who excel in their fields. We believe in giving you responsibility, not a task. We want you to have ownership and pride in your work and see your work's positive impact on your colleagues, our customers, and the world. We believe in providing transparency and support so you can do the best work of your career.

Über TradeLink
TradeLink baut agentische Plattformen, die europäische Lieferketten auf ein neues Level bringen. Routineaufgaben werden dabei von intelligenten KI-Agenten übernommen, wichtige Entscheidungen und Priorisierungen bleiben in den Teams. Ein Netzwerk, das Unternehmen, Lieferanten und Spediteure verbindet, sorgt für maximale Transparenz, reduziert Zeitverluste und schafft einen sicheren und vertrauensvollen Prozess. Mit TradeLink hat man seine Logistik jederzeit im Griff, statt ihr hinterherzurennen.
Mit KI als Hebel trägst du die volle Verantwortung für strategische Enterprise-Accounts - vom ersten Kontakt bis zur Verlängerung und zum Ausbau der Partnerschaft. Dabei bist du weit mehr als Verkäufer:in: Du berätst Head of Logistics & Co. auf ihrem Weg in die AI-Transformation, zeigst ihnen, was mit agentischer KI in ihrer Lieferkette möglich wird, und bringst sie an die vorderste Front dieser Entwicklung - gemeinsam mit uns.
Aufgaben
Neukunden gewinnen & AI-Transformation gestalten: Du erschließt strategische Enterprise-Accounts - und wirst zum vertrauten Berater ihrer AI-Reise. Du hilfst Enterprise Kunden / Logistik Teams das Potenzial agentischer KI zu erkennen und zu heben, und positionierst sie (und TradeLink) an der Spitze der Supply-Chain-Innovation. Von der ersten Ansprache bis zum Abschluss: Du verkaufst nicht nur ein Produkt, du eröffnest eine neue Art zu arbeiten.
Bestehende Accounts ausbauen: Du entwickelst dein Kundenbuch aktiv weiter - von der klassischen Slotbooking-Nutzung hin zu unserem neuen AI Promise-Produkt und in weitere agentische Workflows hinein.
Probleme verstehen, bevor du Lösungen anbietest: Du hörst zu, fragst nach und verstehst die operativen Herausforderungen deiner Kund:innen wirklich - und übersetzt sie in konkrete AI-Chancen und selbst aufgebaute Pipeline, statt auf eingehende Anfragen zu warten.
Workshops mit Entscheider:innen führen: Du planst und moderierst Workshops mit Enterprise-Entscheider:innen, die Klarheit schaffen und den nächsten kommerziellen Schritt definieren.
Onboarding & Rollout absichern: Gemeinsam mit deinem Product Builder - deinem technischen Tandem-Partner - sorgst du dafür, dass Kunden sauber onboarded werden und technische Anfragen zügig gelöst werden.
KI als Hebel nutzen: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem GTM Engineering zusammen, um KI-gestützte Prozesse in deinem Vertriebsalltag laufend zu verbessern.
Qualifikation
>5 Jahre Erfahrung im Vertrieb oder Account Management mit Enterprise-Kunden, inklusive eigenständig abgeschlossener Deals mit einem Vertragswert von mindestens €50.000
Praktische Erfahrung darin, KI in den eigenen Sales-Prozess zu integrieren - über reines Prompting hinaus
Erfahrung in Planung, Durchführung und erfolgreichem Abschluss von Workshops mit Enterprise-Entscheider:innen
Die Fähigkeit, schwierige Priorisierungsentscheidungen zu treffen und diese mit klarer eigener Argumentation zu vertreten
Echte Neugier : Du willst Kundenprobleme wirklich verstehen, bevor du über Lösungen sprichst
Freude an Verhandlungen und am Aufbau von Beziehungen - auch unaufgefordert und über den aktuellen Deal hinaus
Erfahrung in der engen Zusammenarbeit mit technischen Teams - Product, Engineering oder Solution Consulting sind von Vorteil
Branchennähe zu Logistik, Supply Chain oder angrenzenden operativen B2B-Umfeldern wären optimal

Impact, Innovation & Ownership: Gestalte unser schnell wachsendes, AI-natives B2B-Startup in der Logistik mit. Wir arbeiten in kleinen, fokussierten Pods, in denen jede:r echte Ergebnisse verantwortet – nicht nur Aufgaben abarbeitet. Nimm Einfluss auf Produkt, Kundenlösungen, Wachstum und Marke. Wir denken groß, handeln schnell und lösen echte Probleme.
AI-Powered, Human-Led: Arbeite an vorderster Front einer Organisation, die AI-nativ aufgebaut ist. Du nutzt AI, um deinen Impact zu vervielfachen – während Urteilsvermögen, Kreativität und Ownership klar menschlich bleiben.
Schnell lernen und wachsen: Kontinuierliches Feedback, 360°-Reviews und ein eigenes Development-Budget, um genau die Skills aufzubauen, die du brauchst. Arbeite eng mit einem erfahrenen Managament Team zusammen, die Richtung vorgeben – statt deinen Alltag im Detail zu steuern.
Leidenschaftliches Team: Werde Teil eines motivierten, unterstützenden Teams, das Klarheit, Ownership und echten Impact schätzt. In unseren Pods arbeitest du in engen, eingespielten Teams – mit echter Zusammenarbeit statt nur geteilten Tools.
Kultur & Zugehörigkeit: Inklusiv, divers und mit Spaß an der Sache – von virtuellen Team-Events bis zu unvergesslichen Offsites schaffen wir überall ein starkes Gemeinschaftsgefühl, inklusive regelmäßigem gemeinsamem Co-Working in Berlin und München.
Am Erfolg beteiligt sein: Über unser VSOP-Programm hast du direkten Anteil am Wachstum des Unternehmens
Auch wenn du dir nicht zu 100 % sicher bist, ob du alle Kriterien erfüllst, möchten wir dich ausdrücklich ermutigen, dich trotzdem zu bewerben. Neugier, Begeisterung für digitale Innovation, Lernbereitschaft, Teamgeist und eine echte Growth-Mindset-Mentalität sind für uns am wichtigsten.
TradeLink ist fest davon überzeugt, dass Vielfalt eine große Stärke ist, und setzt sich für ein respektvolles, sicheres und offenes Umfeld für alle ein, die bei oder mit uns arbeiten. Um unbewusste Vorurteile im Bewerbungsprozess zu reduzieren, kannst du dein Bewerbungsfoto gern weglassen.

As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform.

Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We’re also a mission-driven company. We cultivate an inclusive culture that gives every CrowdStriker both the flexibility and autonomy to own their careers.

We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

About the Role: Directly sells enterprise security software solutions across the breadth of the company's products and drives incremental revenue with new customers, primarily through flexible and scalable licensing models.

This field sales role has primary accountability for the planning. prospecting. qualification, and closing of revenue on new business accounts.

Additionally, this role develops the post close relationship within newly won accounts during the initial months by partnering with internal stakeholders who are accountable for onboarding, accelerated adoption expansion, and drawdown of flexible licensing models.

Incumbents effectively collaborate with other teams, including Account Managers, Customer Success, Sales Engineering, Professional Services, Marketing, Channel / Alliances sales teams, Finance and Customer Support, as well as extemal parties such as Alliance and Channel Partners.

What You'll Need: Holds expert-level experience and uses professional concepts and company objectives to resolve complex issues in creative and effective ways.

Deep industry knowledge and understanding of a customer's decision-making process: goals, strategies, and business objectives Expert-level presentation, customer service, financial/business acumen, and negotiation skills at all levels of customer engagement.

Complete, "big-picture" understanding of the business and technical contexts of key account opportunities. Driven, self-starter who exudes leadership on account set and compels others to get on Fully adept at consultative effectiveness and establishing trust with internal and external customers.

Fully functional knowledge of sales methodologies, techniques, and the sales lifecycle of security software solutions, software business value concepts, and the company's products.

What You'll Do: Prospects, identifies, qualifies, and closes new customer revenue within assigned accounts by building relationships with key decision makers, typically using flexible and scalable licensing models (e.g. Falcon Flex).

Develops and executes a comprehensive business plan for each account, including identifying core customer requirements and mapping the benefits of CrowdStrike's solutions to customer business requirements.

Coordinates with internal stakeholders during customer onboarding, accelerated adoption of products, expansion, and eventual transition of accounts after the initial months to expansion/renewal focused Account Managers.

Timely documentation within CRM/ Marketing software of customer contact and activity data is required of the role (e.g. names, titles, contact information, opportunity value, product information, sales stages, probability, business pain, firm-future commitments.

Accountable for accurate forecasting, regular quarterly revenue delivery, and the implementation of agreed account and business plans. Promotes CrowdStrike's products, maximizes brand recognition and mindshare at all levels. and publicizes success stories. Provides customer feedback to internal stakeholders for product, systems, and process.

Work is primarily performed in the field away from home office or company office location in order to accomplish the duties of the position. At this level, incumbents will have expert-level knowledge of selling the company's products and services.

Assigned accounts are larger and of the most complex nature, where assigned quota is typically higher than lesser-scoped portfolio sales role levels.

(Size of quota may be relative to complexity and nature of account set.) Incumbents routinely sell-to and interact with executive-level customer decision makers. to include up to CO levels and are typically assigned to Enterprise accounts segmentation or commensurately complex public sector accounts.

At Instagrid, you are part of the clean-tech revolution by bringing pure energy into your region, helping professional workers transitioning away from combustion generators and making it possible for them to experience a safe, efficient, clean and silent energy solution.

As an Account Executive for the Netherlands, you will drive Instagrid's growth in your region by winning new customers and expanding existing accounts. You will own the full sales cycle, build lasting relationships with key stakeholders, and act as the face of Instagrid in your market — bringing clean energy to professionals who need it most.

Own the full sales cycle from first contact to close - you drive revenue and set the pace
Build and grow a complex, multilocation key account portfolio, identifying and reaching the right decision-makers independently
Shape how Instagrid goes to market in the Netherlands - your insights directly influence strategy, product, and marketing
Develop a strong, sustainable pipeline by becoming a trusted long-term partner to your accounts
Engage key opinion leaders and industry influencers to put Instagrid on the map where it matters
Feed real market intelligence back into the business - on customers, competition, trends, and product gaps
5+ years in B2B sales, ideally with high-quality hardware or technical products
A proven track record closing complex deals and managing multilocation accounts
Experience coordinating or leading a national sales team
Sharp communicator and confident negotiator - comfortable with senior stakeholders
Customer-first mindset with a professional, credible presence in the field
Fluent in Dutch and English
Business or engineering background - degree or equivalent experience

s.h: A competitive salary with a fixed and variable component
s.t:
Flexible work schedules and remote work
A car allowance
30 days of paid vacation
Up to 5 special leave days
The opportunity to join a company at the cutting edge of its field
A laptop and a mobile phone (iOS)
This is Instagrid
Pure instant power. Anywhere. We have created the world’s most advanced portable power supplies, bringing freedom to the way our customers work. With you we want to shape a world where advanced technology meets environmental responsibility and create lasting impact.

Driven by our curiosity and the desire to leave tomorrow's world cleaner than we found it yesterday. Join us in transitioning away from combustion generators to a cleaner alternative for fast, measurable, and real outcomes. What we’ve achieved so far is just the beginning.

We do not just accept diversity but actively search for the best talent regardless of gender, ethnical origin, age, religion, sexual orientation or place of origin. Deine Aufgaben Deine Mission: Werde zum Wachstumsmotor von Deutschlands größter Nachbarschaftsplattform
Du willst nicht nur Media-Budgets verwalten, sondern den Markt aktiv gestalten? Du hast den Instinkt für große Deals und die Ausdauer, Marken dort zu platzieren, wo sie echtes Vertrauen genießen?
Bei nebenan.de bringen wir starke Brands direkt in das digitale Zuhause von über 4 Millionen aktiven Nutzer:innen. Wir suchen keinen "Verwalter", sondern einen Senior Sales Profi, der unser Werbegeschäft mit Biss, Kreativität und unternehmerischem Mut auf das nächste Level hebt.
Jagdinstinkt trifft Strategie Pipeline-Architekt & Hunter: Du baust dir deinen eigenen Kundenstamm von Grund auf auf. Dabei nutzt du Kaltakquise als Werkzeug und identifizierst durch eigenständige Lead-Recherche – massiv unterstützt durch unsere internen KI-Tools – die Brands, die perfekt zu unserer Plattform passen
Deal-Closing auf Entscheiderebene: Du gewinnst große Marken und Mediaagenturen für hyperlokale und nationale Kampagnen. Du begleitest den gesamten Prozess von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme bis zum finalen Vertragsabschluss.
Scale bigger: Du denkst nicht in Standardpaketen. Du suchst aktiv nach Hebeln, um Budgets zu skalieren, Add-ons zu platzieren und crossmediale Konzepte umzusetzen, die nachhaltig Eindruck hinterlassen.
Kreativer Sparringspartner: Du entwickelst proaktiv „um die Ecke gedachte“ Ansätze für deine Kund:innen, um deren Sichtbarkeit und Wirksamkeit auf der Plattform zu maximieren.
Vorbild & Mentor:in: Du teilst deine Sales-Experience im Team, pushst die Ambition deiner Kolleg:innen und hilfst uns, als Einheit über uns hinauszuwachsen.
Dein Profil Abschlussstärke ist deine DNA Erfahrung: Du bringst 4-5+ Jahre fundierte Erfahrung im Media- oder Ad-Sales mit, idealerweise mit einem Fokus auf Branding- oder Plattformkampagnen.
Erfolgsbilanz: Dein Track Record ist tadellos – du hast bereits nachweislich große Marken überzeugt und signifikante Umsatztreiber etabliert.
Hunter-Mentalität: Du brennst für den Vertrieb. Kaltakquise schreckt dich nicht ab, sondern spornt dich an. Du hast den unbedingten Willen zum Erfolg und arbeitest leidenschaftlich an deinen Zielen.
Netzwerk: Du verfügst über ein belastbares Netzwerk in der Agentur- und Markenwelt, das du sofort aktivieren kannst.
Mindset: Du denkst groß und mutig. Wo andere Hindernisse sehen, findest du Wege, um das Ticket zu heben und die Idee noch stärker aufzuladen.
Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest selbstorganisiert, hochgradig fokussiert und mit einem echten unternehmerischen Spirit.
Was wir bieten Ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit einer Kombination aus Büro- und Remote-Tagen
Einen sinnstiftenden Job – wir bauen ein großartiges Produkt, das echten Mehrwert für Communities liefert
Arbeiten in einem fröhlichen, erfahrenen Team, das Wissen teilt und voneinander lernt
Einblicke in den gesamten Arbeitsprozess unseres Social Startups sowie der nebenan.de Stiftung
Deine nebenan.de SpenditCard – jeden Monat erhältst Du zusätzlich 35 € zur freien Verfügung
30 Tage Jahresurlaub, plus die Möglichkeit von Workation-Modellen und Sabbaticals
Eine stärkenorientierte Entwicklungskultur (wir arbeiten mit dem Gallup StrengthsFinder)
Ein Büro in Berlin-Kreuzberg und regelmäßige Events wie Yoga oder „Lunch & Learn“-Sessions
Wir bieten dir die Chance, in einem Umfeld zu arbeiten, das Impact mit Performance verbindet. Du gestaltest die Zukunft unseres Advertising-Geschäfts aktiv mit und profitierst von einer Plattform, die als "Zuhause für Marken mit Haltung" echtes Alleinstellungsmerkmal genießt.

Categoria: Comercial Localização: VAGA ABERTA Você é apaixonado por vendas, tecnologia e quer fazer parte de um time que está transformando o mercado de soluções em TI? Estamos fortalecendo nosso time comercial com profissionais que tenham perfil consultivo, organização e foco em resultados.

Buscamos um(a) Account Manager com visão de mercado e alta capacidade de execução para liderar o desenvolvimento e a consolidação de parcerias B2B.

Sua missão principal será a prospecção ativa e a conversão de novos negócios, posicionando o portfólio ManageEngine como o motor de eficiência para infraestrutura e segurança de TI em contas estratégicas.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições Expansão de Mercado: Identificar e prospectar novas oportunidades de alto valor, mapeando decisores e influenciadores no cenário B2B.

Venda Consultiva: Atuar como um conselheiro estratégico, traduzindo necessidades técnicas complexas em soluções de negócio tangíveis, garantindo que o cliente perceba o valor real das ferramentas ManageEngine.

Gestão de Ciclo de Vendas: Gerenciar todas as etapas do funil de vendas, desde a abordagem inicial e diagnóstico até a negociação comercial e o fechamento de contratos robustos.

Relacionamento de Longo Prazo: Cultivar e expandir relacionamentos em contas estratégicas, visando não apenas a venda pontual, mas o crescimento da conta e a fidelização do cliente através de um atendimento de excelência.

Inteligência Competitiva: Manter-se atualizado sobre as tendências de TI e o ecossistema de soluções ManageEngine para superar a concorrência e oferecer o melhor custo-benefício aos clientes. O que esperamos de você Mentalidade orientada a resultados ( hunter ) e habilidade comprovada em vendas complexas (B2B).

Excelente capacidade de comunicação e oratória para apresentações executivas. Perfil analítico para diagnosticar dores operacionais e sugerir melhorias baseadas no portfólio de soluções.

Responsabilidades Gerenciar e desenvolver um portfólio de clientes ManageEngine, garantindo relacionamento de longo prazo e alto nível de satisfação; Atuar como ponto focal entre cliente e times técnico, pré-vendas e comercial; Entender o cenário do cliente e propor evolução do ambiente com foco em tecnologia e segurança; Apoiar clientes na adoção e maturidade das soluções ManageEngine; Acompanhar indicadores de sucesso, retenção e expansão da carteira; Trabalhar em conjunto com implantação, suporte e pré-vendas para garantir jornada eficiente; Manter o CRM atualizado com informações estratégicas.

O que oferecemos Atuação com soluções líderes globais em gestão e segurança de TI; Ambiente colaborativo, com autonomia e visão estratégica; Acesso a treinamentos e certificações ManageEngine; Oportunidade real de crescimento (Key Account / Especialista / Liderança); Participação em campanhas e projetos estratégicos.

Obrigatórios Experiência prévia como Account Manager, Customer Success ou Executivo de Contas em tecnologia; Vivência com clientes B2B (preferencialmente SaaS / TI / segurança); Comunicação consultiva e habilidade de conduzir reuniões executivas; Organização, visão analítica e foco em expansão de contas.

Desejáveis Experiência com soluções ManageEngine; Vivência com vendas recorrentes (subscription / licenciamento); Inglês intermediário; Experiência com CRM (Zoho será diferencial).

About Agicap
Created in Lyon in 2016 by three French entrepreneurs, Agicap is one of the fastest scale-ups in Europe, with over 8000 customers, 650 employees and fast revenue growth (7x between 2021 and 2024). Agicap is part of the French Tech 120, rewarding the most promising startups in France.
Agicap allows Finance teams of Mid-Market companies to efficiently manage and forecast their cash, pay their suppliers and get paid. By combining a Treasury Management System, and Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable solutions into a single platform, Agicap aims at becoming the next leading Treasury Management platform for mid-market companies.
We have raised €145M since our creation, with prestigious VC funds including AVP, Greenoaks, Partech and BlackFin, with a last round in November 2024.
These additional resources further fuel our product innovation, allowing us to grow significantly and accelerate our international expansion across the world.
We believe our success comes from our highly passionate and dedicated teams, committed to building a company where people can grow and build their careers. We are constantly looking for great talents, aiming for excellence and ready to join our ambitious adventure!

s.h: About the Account Executive - SMB role
s.t:
We are growing our team in Düsseldorf! Working closely with the Business Development team, Outbound SDRs, Inbound SDRs and Partnership Managers on a daily basis, your mission will be to generate new business by acquiring new clients.
As an SMB Account Executive at Agicap, you will drive sales and expand our customer base within the SMB segment. You will play a crucial role in identifying new business opportunities, building relationships with potential clients and closing deals in order to achieve your sales targets.

Defining and implementing a sectoral development strategy with your SDRs.
Identifying and targeting SMB companies that could benefit from Agicap’s financial management solutions.
Conducting product demonstrations and presentations to showcase the value of Agicap’s offerings.
Developing and maintaining a robust sales pipeline through prospecting, networking, and referrals.
Building and nurturing relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers within target organizations.
Negotiating contracts and closing sales to meet or exceed quarterly and annual sales targets.
Staying informed about industry developments, competitor activities, and market trends.
Regularly monitoring and analyzing your performance with Management to identify areas for improvement.
Providing feedback to the Marketing, Business Development, and Product teams to improve processes and the product.
Sharing your commercial expertise and good ideas to enhance the team’s performance.

Native/Bilingual level of German
2-4 years of experience in B2B Sales, preferably in the SaaS industry and with mid-market space, and with some experience working in a finance department/audit/consulting/TS.
Studies background in a top business or Engineering school.
A passion for sales and a proven track record of meeting and exceeding targets.
A tenacious, resilient salesperson who never gives up and is driven by results.
Someone who can put themselves in the shoes of business leaders to understand their current and future cash flow needs.
Strong analytical and synthesis skills, excellent verbal communication, and a high level of intellectual curiosity.
Great ambition, with the drive to meet and even exceed objectives.
A strong business acumen and above-average interpersonal skills.
A team spirit and a desire to share knowledge, helping colleagues grow.

s.t:
Exceptional product-market fit, confirmed by our latest funding round:
Crucial need → cash = the lifeblood of business, top priority for CFOs (PwC)

A growth engine of a large Outbound SDR team, Inbound & Partner leads to help you scale fast!

Own the full new business cycle – from identifying and approaching qualified leads to closing deals and handing over seamlessly to our Account Management team.

Manage a strong pipeline of qualified leads and opportunities, ensuring consistent momentum and measurable results.
Pitch our SaaS solutions to mid-sized and high growth businesses across various industry verticals – via video calls, phone, email, or on-site meetings when needed.
Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, partnerships, account management, and customer success to deliver a customer-first experience and help shape a digital world people can trust.
Engage e-commerce decision-makers and build compelling cases for partnering with Trusted Shops.
Actively contribute to lead definition, qualification, and acquisition – bringing your insights and creativity to the table.
3+ years of sales experience in the SaaS industry or in selling complex, consultative digital products or software solutions.
Deep understanding of e-commerce platforms and a strong grasp of the SaaS landscape – you know the market and the players.
Proven track record in sales , with experience managing diverse deals and stakeholders across the pipeline – from mid-sized clients to fast-growing enterprises.
Proactive and results-driven mindset – you're motivated by success, learn from setbacks, and continuously strive to improve.
Exceptional communication skills , quick thinking, and a strategic approach to navigating complex sales conversations.
Collaborative team player , able to work effectively with internal teams and build strong relationships with prospects and clients.
Highly motivated and target-oriented , with the ability to not just meet but regularly exceed ambitious sales goals.
Fluency in German and English (spoken and written) – you communicate confidently and professionally in both languages, especially in negotiation and client-facing situations.

This role requires a commercially sharp enterprise sales professional with deep knowledge of AEC workflows and a proven track record of exceeding revenue targets in a complex, multi-stakeholder environment.

Owns the end-to-end growth strategy for a select portfolio of high-potential AEC accounts (characterized by low current penetration relative to their potential spend). Develops and executes plans to maximize ARR through strategic upsell, cross-sell, and solution adoption.
Cultivates and expands relationships with senior-level stakeholders and decision-makers within assigned accounts globally, aligning Chaos solutions with their core business objectives and long-term strategic vision.
Creates and presents compelling ROI and business value analyses to justify significant new investments in the Chaos ecosystem, focusing on demonstrating measurable impact on the client's AEC workflows.
Leads the negotiation and closing of complex, multi-year expansion deals globally, navigating diverse procurement and legal processes unique to large AEC firms.
Identifies opportunities for workflow transformation within client organizations, positioning Chaos as integral to their design and visualization processes.
Develops and manages a robust, long-term sales pipeline for the assigned portfolio, providing accurate and reliable forecasting for expansion revenue.
Maintains expertise on global AEC industry trends, digital transformation initiatives, competitive landscapes, and client innovation priorities to proactively identify and seize growth opportunities.

Required Experience
At least 5 years of experience in enterprise sales, strategic account management, or business development within the AEC sector or an adjacent technology environment.
Demonstrated track record of consistently exceeding expansion and net-new revenue targets in a complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales environment: able to speak to the numbers, what was planned, and what was delivered.
Proven experience managing and growing a portfolio of large enterprise accounts, with clear ownership of upsell and cross-sell outcomes across long sales cycles.
Deep familiarity with AEC workflows, digital design and visualisation technologies, including BIM and real-time rendering, and SaaS licensing models.
Experience negotiating and closing complex, multi-year enterprise contracts, including development of executive-level business cases demonstrating TCO and ROI.
Required Skills
Navigates complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals with commercial sharpness and discipline: manages long sales cycles without losing momentum, and closes with consistency.
Builds credible, trusted relationships with C-level and senior executive stakeholders, engaging at the level of business strategy rather than product features.
Develops rigorous account plans and pipeline strategies, using data and account intelligence to identify where to invest time and where to expand coverage.
Creates commercial momentum proactively, surfaces new expansion opportunities and builds pipeline rather than waiting for demand to appear.
Applies intellectual curiosity and second-order thinking to get beneath the surface of a client's needs, uncovering the true business pain points that shape a winning solution.
Translates complex technical capabilities into clear business value narratives that resonate with both technical users and executive decision-makers.
Operates with a high degree of autonomy and self-discipline: manages territory, pipeline, and stakeholder relationships without close oversight

* Du denkst und handelst unternehmerisch, strukturiert und kundenorientiert und verstehst es, bestehende Kundenbeziehungen nachhaltig auszubauen und neue Kunden zu gewinnen.
